## Houston 1.0.9

### What's new

- **Post your org chart to LinkedIn.** In Admin > Org chart, Share now posts the chart image straight to your LinkedIn profile. Connect LinkedIn once, edit the post if you like, and Houston opens it in your browser when it's live.
- **Slack connects inside the desktop app.** Connecting Slack on desktop now finishes in Houston, with no browser prompt to return to the app.
- **Attach files when answering a question.** When an AI Employee asks you something, you can attach files to your answer.

### Fixes and polish

- If you leave Houston open for days, a downloaded update now installs when you come back.
- An update no longer downloads twice.
- A routine that was deleted no longer shows an error.
- When your Google Cloud project can't use a Vertex model, Houston now says so instead of showing a generic error.
- More reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
